blocks.text: Jenny came through the gap between the burning boards and stopped beside a yellow fire hydrant.
blocks.alt: Jenny faces Laura on the street beside a yellow fire hydrant, with Dork’s modified tank beyond the burning debris.

blocks.text: The woman in black stepped into her path.
Behind her, the tank’s tracks scraped across the street. Jenny caught a glimpse of copper at the front of its turret.
Then a bright ball left the woman’s lips.
Flaming Head’s warning came back at once.
Laura.
Jenny planted one boot and kicked.
blocks.alt: Jenny kicks a bright plasma ball back toward Laura, where it catches only the loose edge of Laura’s coat.

blocks.text: The ball flew back across the gap. Laura twisted aside, but its edge caught the loose hem of her coat.
She tore the coat off and stamped out the little flame.
“Nice kick.”
Jenny lowered her foot.
Laura circled toward the tank, keeping Jenny in front of her.
“Where’s that flaming-head friend of yours?”
“He went to the Sun to get back the strength you and your goons stole.”
Laura smiled. “Must have worked. I’m stronger than ever.”
Jenny kept her hands up. “He hasn’t come back.”
Laura’s smile faded.
blocks.alt: Two panels contrast Laura’s brief sadness with her renewed anger as she spits plasma and Jenny dodges.

blocks.text: Her eyes dropped to the scorched coat. For a moment, she seemed to forget Jenny was there.
The tank’s engine revved behind her.
Laura glanced toward it, then set her jaw. Jenny wasn’t getting through.
“Well, I never forgave him for making me like this!”
She spat a bright ball at Jenny’s face.
Jenny slipped aside. “You’re a powerful woman. What’s wrong with that?”
The shot scorched the pavement. Laura stepped in and threw a punch.
Jenny ducked the punch.
A second strike passed beside her mask. She slipped around Laura’s shoulder, close enough that Laura had to turn before she could aim another shot.
Laura kicked.
Jenny was already out of reach.
Across the street, Fist came around the stone planter. Jenny saw his red glove rise above the curb.
She glanced at the hydrant.
Laura spat again. Jenny’s boots blurred as she cut sideways, kicking up dust.
blocks.alt: Laura spits plasma and misses as Jenny dodges with blurred feet and dust rising from the pavement; Fist approaches the hydrant.

blocks.text: The hydrant stood to their left, its broad side outlet facing the road.
Jenny moved another pace.
The plasma struck empty pavement behind her. Laura turned to follow.
“Fist! The hydrant!”
Jenny pointed, then darted sideways.
Fist dropped low.
His red knuckles struck the yellow iron.
blocks.alt: Fist punches the hydrant’s side outlet, sending a powerful sideways stream into Laura as Jenny darts clear.

blocks.text: The side of the hydrant broke with a crack.
Water burst across the street.
It caught Laura squarely before she could turn. Her boots skidded. She threw her arms wide, trying to brace against the rush.
The stream drove her backward.
Jenny stopped beyond its reach, curls swinging around her mask.
Laura lost her footing.
blocks.alt: The rushing water sweeps Laura backward toward the far curb while Jenny stands clear and Laura’s discarded coat tumbles separately.

blocks.text: Water swept her across the pavement toward the opposite curb. Her discarded coat tumbled through the gutter behind her.
She tried to get a knee under herself. The water pushed her sideways again.
Fist floated clear of the broken hydrant. The stream kept pouring through the opening he had made.
Laura reached the curb and caught its edge with both hands.
She hauled herself out of the main rush and sat hard on the shallow step beyond it.
Her ponytail dripped. She wiped water from her mask and glared across the road.
Jenny met her eyes.
An officer emerged from the stone doorway behind Laura. His partner followed with a fire extinguisher, one hand on its hose.
Jenny pointed toward the scorched coat.
“Watch her mouth. Plasma.”
The second officer raised the nozzle. Laura looked at it, then stayed still.
The first officer drew her hands behind her back and fastened the cuffs.
He helped her to her feet and led her toward a police car waiting in the side street.
blocks.alt: Jenny offers Laura a place with the Defenders as the soaked, handcuffed Laura is escorted to a police car; angry Jaws hovers nearby and the second officer carries an extinguisher.

blocks.text: Water dripped from her ponytail and sleeves. The second officer followed with the extinguisher ready.
Jenny stepped closer. “You should have stayed away from Dork. He was just using you.”
Laura looked back at her.
“If you want to help the city, join the Defenders.”
Jaws swooped in above the officers, his metal teeth snapping.
“She doesn’t need you!” he barked at Jenny.
Then he turned toward the car. “Don’t worry, Laura. We’ll bail you out!”
Laura’s eyes went back to Jenny. She said nothing as the officer guided her toward the open door.
Jaws wheeled away toward the tank.
Fist came beside Jenny, his red cuff and inset white panel trailing behind him.
Beyond the running water, the tank’s engine rose again.
Jenny turned toward it.
